ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened largely unchanged, with Bitcoin slipping 0.2% to $83,372 and Ethereum down 0.3%, while BNB, XRP and DOGE posted modest gains. Institutional activity is picking up as Standard Chartered rolls out Bitcoin and Ether trading for UAE professionals, but regulatory headwinds persist with Kraken’s EU bank acquisition and BitMEX’s UK lawsuit. New bStocks tokens were added on Delta India, adding diversification options for traders.
